{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|It bites you, you die in minutes, no antidote.|Tribless Sha, regarding Kodashi vipers and their venom|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref>}}
The '''venom''' of the '''Kodashi viper''' was a powerful neurotoxin that was capable of [[Death/Legends|killing]] an adult [[Human/Legends|Human]] within [[Time/Legends|minutes]] of being bitten by the snake. There was no known antidote for the venom of the [[Kodashi viper]], and those who were subjected to its effects cried out in absolute agony before they died. The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] made use of Kodashi vipers to attack several members of the [[Broken Columns Clan]] of male Dathomiri warriors. Four of the six attacked men died from the effects of the serpent's venom.
